items: We already use Shopify automations and Zapier. Isn't that enough?

Shopify Flow and basic automation tools are great starting points, but they hit limits fast. Ecommerce operations have complex workflows that need sophisticated logic, error handling, multi-system orchestration, and custom integrations with 3PLs, marketplaces, and ERPs. We build enterprise-grade systems that scale with your order volume and handle the complexity basic tools can't.
How do I know this will work for our specific store?

That's exactly why we start with a comprehensive audit. We don't propose solutions until we deeply understand your operations, your stack, and your biggest bottlenecks. Our discovery process ensures we're solving your actual problems. You see the roadmap and expected results before you commit to any implementation.
What if our team resists the change?

We've implemented automation across dozens of ecommerce brands. Change management is built into our methodology. We involve your team early, design solutions that make their jobs easier rather than threatening them, and provide comprehensive training. When people see automation eliminating their most frustrating manual tasks, adoption happens naturally.
Isn't custom automation expensive and time-consuming?

Traditional automation projects can be. Our approach is different. We use proven frameworks, pre-built integrations, and rapid development techniques to deliver custom systems in weeks, at a fraction of traditional costs. You get enterprise-level automation without enterprise-level budgets or timelines.
How quickly will we see ROI?

Most clients see measurable time savings within 30 days of deployment. Full ROI typically happens within 3–6 months, depending on scope and order volume. During discovery we calculate expected ROI based on your specific costs and opportunities, so you know exactly what to expect before work begins.
How much does this cost?

Pricing depends on scope: automating a single workflow like abandoned cart recovery is very different from a full operations overhaul. Most engagements are quoted after the discovery audit, once we know exactly what needs to be built. We'll always give you a clear fixed price before any work begins — no surprise invoices.
Will automation replace our team?

No. Our goal is to remove the repetitive, low-value ops work so your team can focus on the parts of the job that require real judgement — customer relationships, buying decisions, brand strategy. Most clients use the freed-up capacity to handle higher order volumes or launch new channels rather than reduce headcount.
Is our data secure during this process?

Yes. We follow least-privilege access practices, use secure authenticated connections for every integration, and never store more data than a workflow needs to function. Specific security requirements can be discussed and agreed upon before any access is granted.
Do you only work with large ecommerce brands?
No. We work with brands of all sizes, from founder-led DTC stores to multi-brand ecommerce operations. The audit and roadmap scale to your current order volume and complexity.
What happens after the automation is built?

Every project includes documentation and team training so you're never locked in. We also offer ongoing support and retainer options if you'd like us to monitor, maintain, and extend the system as your store grows.
Can you work with our existing ecommerce tech stack?

In almost every case, yes. Whether you're on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or a custom setup — with Klaviyo, Gorgias, a 3PL, multiple marketplaces, or your own ERP — we build on top of what you already have. Switching platforms is rarely necessary and adds cost and disruption without improving the outcome.
How is this different from hiring an in-house automation person?

An in-house hire is one person with one skill set. We bring a full team's worth of ecommerce automation, AI, and integration expertise on demand — without the overhead of a full-time salary, benefits, or ramp-up time. And when your needs change, our engagement scales with them.
